items.name: kanban
items.title: Kanban
items.description: Drag-and-drop kanban board (KanbanBoard, KanbanColumn, KanbanCard) on dnd-kit: controlled columns with onChange, WIP limit warning, empty state, add-button slot, one drag handle per card, pointer, touch and keyboard dragging, Korean screen-reader announcements.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Card, column and handle ids must be unique across the board. Keyboard: Space/Enter lift, arrows move, Space drop, Esc cancel. Set lang="ko" on the wrapper; announcements are Korean.
